property.title: Writes confined to destination coefficient array
property.candidate_statement: A frame check can target the fact that the only visible writes are to r->coeffs[i] for i in [0, MLKEM_N), with no allocation, deallocation, or explicit global-state update in the body.

supporting_evidence.excerpt: for (i = 0; i < MLKEM_N; i++) { r->coeffs[i] = (int16_t)(r->coeffs[i] + b->coeffs[i]); }
supporting_evidence.supports_claim: The only visible write target is the destination coefficient array inside a bounded loop.

content.intended_check: Check that the visible footprint of mlk_poly_add is limited to writes through r->coeffs[i] and that a disjoint witness object remains unchanged across the call; no modular arithmetic or full functional equivalence is claimed.

No claim that the routine performs modular-q reduction locally.
No claim of full functional correctness or polynomial-equivalence proof.
No aliasing guarantee between r and b is introduced.
No claim that a disjoint witness sentinel is a complete analysis of all possible out-of-footprint writes.
